== Notes ==
{{Bug|1=Because the recharge reduction of "None Shall Pass!" is applied after percentile reductions such as [[Quickening Zephyr]], the recharge can be reduced below 0. The skill will display as 'recharging' indefinitely but actually can be used again after 10 minutes and 55 seconds, which indicates that Guild Wars uses an unsigned 16 bit integer to store the recharge time in hundredths of a second (2<sup>16</sup>−1 cs = 65,535 cs = 10min 55.35s).}}

* Useful for [[Kite|kiting]] [[melee]] foes.
{{DEFAULTSORT:None Shall Pass!}}
== Trivia ==
*Likely a reference to the Black Knight appearing in the movie ''Monty Python and the Holy Grail'' where he would duel with King Arthur after restricting passage. The same Black Knight's line was also used in [["It's Just a Flesh Wound."]] after having his other arm chopped off and prompted to surrender.
